questions.question: In a psalm praising God's creation, what big picture does the writer paint of the trees, birds, goats and rock badgers?

answers.text: God gives each creature its place
Every creature must fight for space
People rule over the wild places

questions.question: In a psalm about creation, why did God set a boundary that the waters cannot cross?

answers.text: So they never cover the earth again
So the ships can sail safely
So the fish stay in one place

questions.question: In a psalm praising God's works, what happens to living creatures when God takes away their breath?

answers.text: They die and return to dust
They fall into a deep sleep
They wander off to the sea
